GENERAL HEADQUARTERS
SUPREME COMMANDER FOR THE ALLIED POWERS
AG 311.1 (16 Oct 45) GC
(SCAPIN-149)
16 October 1945
MEMORANDUM FOR : IMPERIAL JAPANESE GOVERNMENT.
THROUGH : Central Liaison Office, Tokyo.
SUBJECT : Regulations Controlling Mail, Baggage and Passengers on Air Courier.
1. Refer to our radio ZAX 6696 in which it was stated that details as to control of Japanese mail and passengers carried by air courier service would be issued at a later date. You are informed that effective this date the following regulations will govern control of mail, baggage and passengers carried by air courier service:
a. All baggage including mail bags will be subject to inspection by the pilot of the aircraft to insure that nothing is being carried that will jeopardize the safe conduct of the flight, such as weapons, explosives and the like.
b. The Japanese Government will insure that only those persons conducting official business authorized by the Japanese Government will use this air courier service. This courier service will not be used to conduct commercial or private business.
c. A passenger list for each flight will be furnished to the pilot of the aircraft before loading. This list will contain each passenger’s name, his official title, a brief statement of business he is conducting, point of departure and destination.
d. The pilot of the aircraft has the right to refuse passage to anyone violating these and other regulations governing this air courier service.
FOR THE SUPREME COMMANDER:
H.W.ALLEN,
Colonel, A.G.D.,
Asst Adjutant General.
